raw_candidates.claim: Comparing available anonymized origin tags may separate retry and import accounts.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: Import duplication predicts shared batch origins; retry duplication predicts repeated attempt origins within a transaction path.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Opposing trustworthy origin tags defeat each account; indistinguishable or unreliable tags leave the comparison inconclusive.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: inspect tag completeness and compare duplicate groups while retaining ambiguous groups.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Tag semantics and completeness are unknown; there is no proposed winner.

raw_candidates.claim: Persistent retry tokens could connect duplicate entries to repeated attempts.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: A shared stable token is predicted by the retry account but is not guaranteed by the import account.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Distinct verified tokens would weaken this retry prediction; missing tokens would prevent this test, not establish import duplication.
raw_candidates.probe: Proposed only: determine whether tokens persist and can be anonymized consistently before assessing links.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Token persistence is indispensable and unknown. No constraint relaxation is requested.

raw_candidates.claim: Closely spaced duplicates might be labeled retries from their timestamps alone.
raw_candidates.causal_relation: The proposal assumes short spacing uniquely identifies retries.
raw_candidates.discriminator: Rejected because time proximity alone cannot support the required causal claim. An import burst could produce the same spacing.
raw_candidates.probe: Parked; no time-only causal verdict proposed.
raw_candidates.uncertainty: Both mechanisms' timing distributions remain unknown; rejection does not establish either mechanism.
